about.intro: Cut, trim, grade and mix on a real multi-track timeline. Native and fast on Mac, Windows and Linux, with nothing to sign up for.
about.description: Bring in your footage, cut it on the timeline, grade it while you watch the scopes, mix the sound against proper loudness meters, then export while you keep editing. It’s the workflow you know from the big editors, without the subscription.

features.title: Every trim
features.body: Ripple, roll, slip, slide, razor and rate stretch, plus three-point editing with insert and overwrite.

features.title: Colour with scopes
features.body: Basic correction, curves, colour wheels, HSL secondary and vignette, checked on the waveform and RGB parade.

features.title: Sound that measures up
features.body: A mixer with faders, sends and automation, clip effects like EQ, DeNoise and a limiter, and loudness meters to EBU R128.

features.title: Titles and captions
features.body: Type, shapes and keyframed motion right on the Program monitor. SRT and WebVTT captions in and out.

features.title: Our own touches
features.body: A dark glass look, a clean Home screen, fade handles on every clip, zoom that stays on the playhead, and double-click a gap to close it.

features.title: Never lose work
features.body: Auto-save keeps a set of versions, and a recovery journal written a second after each edit brings back unsaved changes after a crash.

screenshots.title: The edit
screenshots.caption: Program monitor, keyframes in Effect Controls and a multi-track timeline, all in one calm window.

screenshots.title: The grade
screenshots.caption: The Color workspace puts the scopes next to the picture, so you grade by numbers, not by guesswork.

screenshots.title: The details
screenshots.caption: Transitions, thumbnails and waveforms right on the clips, at any zoom.

about.credit: CutCat is based on FilmCraft by the ArtCraft team, licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0, and modified by RNG Media S.L. RNG Media is not affiliated with or endorsed by the ArtCraft team.

about.pitch: Layers, styles and type. On your machine.
about.intro: A layered photo editor that keeps every edit live and opens your PSDs. No account, no cloud, no subscription.
about.description: Stack adjustment layers, mask them, restyle your type and change your mind as often as you like: your original pixels never change. When you’re done, export it or save it back to PSD.

features.title: Adjustment layers
features.body: Curves, Levels, Vibrance, Hue/Saturation, Black & White, Gradient Map and more, masked to any area and always editable.

features.title: Layer styles
features.body: Drop shadow, glow, bevel, satin, stroke and colour, gradient or pattern overlays, live on any layer, type included.

features.title: Selections that get it
features.body: Marquees, lassos and the Magic Wand, plus Quick Selection and Select Subject, running on your own computer.

features.title: Type that sets well
features.body: Point and paragraph text edited right on the canvas, with full character and paragraph controls.

features.title: PSD, faithfully
features.body: Opens and saves layered PSD files, plus PSB, 16- and 32-bit, CMYK and Lab documents.

features.title: RAW Develop
features.body: Exposure, tone, curves, colour mixer and colour grading in one filter, with a live histogram.

screenshots.title: Layers, all live
screenshots.caption: Type, an Outer Glow and two adjustment layers over the photo, each one still editable.

screenshots.title: Layer Style
screenshots.caption: Every effect has its own page, with a live preview on the canvas.

screenshots.title: RAW Develop
screenshots.caption: Light, colour, curves and grading in one place, with the histogram on top.

about.credit: PhotoFalcon is based on PhotoCraft by the ArtCraft team, licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0, and modified by RNG Media S.L. RNG Media is not affiliated with or endorsed by the ArtCraft team.

about.pitch: Read, mark up and fix any PDF.
about.intro: Comment, organise, combine, fill, sign and protect PDFs in one fast app. Your documents never leave your computer.
about.description: Open a PDF and the tools are right there: highlight and comment, move pages around like cards on a table, merge files, fill in a form, sign it, lock it with a password. It works offline, with no account and no telemetry.

features.title: Reads anything
features.body: Pages render in tiles, so text stays sharp at any zoom. Continuous, two-up, full screen and a quiet Read mode.

features.title: Comments
features.body: Highlights, sticky notes, text boxes, shapes, stamps and drawings, with a Comments panel for replies.

features.title: Organise pages
features.body: Rotate, delete, insert and reorder pages like cards. Combine files and split them, with undo for everything.

features.title: Forms and signing
features.body: Fill in forms, build your own, and sign documents.

features.title: Protect and redact
features.body: Add passwords, redact for real and remove hidden information before you share.

features.title: Every tool, one keystroke away
features.body: Search all tools and commands from one box, or pin the ones you use most.

screenshots.title: Mark it up
screenshots.caption: A highlight with a note, kept in the Comments panel where the team can reply.

screenshots.title: Organise pages
screenshots.caption: Every page as a card: drag to reorder, rotate, delete or insert, then save.

screenshots.title: Read it
screenshots.caption: Fit a page, flip through tabs, and keep every tool one click away.

about.credit: PDFrog is based on PdfCraft by the ArtCraft team, licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0, and modified by RNG Media S.L. RNG Media is not affiliated with or endorsed by the ArtCraft team.

about.pitch: A word processor that just gets on with it.
about.intro: Write, format and review documents with the ribbon you already know. Reads and writes .docx, exports PDF, and works offline.
about.description: Ribbon tabs, styles, shortcuts and lists that behave the way you expect. Open a .docx from anyone, track changes and comments with your team, and send back a clean PDF. Spelling, grammar and everything else run on your computer.

features.title: The ribbon you know
features.body: Home, Insert, Layout, References, Review and View, with live style previews and the shortcuts already in your fingers.

features.title: Your files
features.body: Opens and saves .docx, plus .odt, .rtf, .html, .md and .txt, opens old .doc files, and exports PDF with real, selectable text.

features.title: Review together
features.body: Comments in the margin, track changes with accept and reject, and compare two versions of a document.

features.title: References
features.body: Tables of contents, footnotes, citations and bibliographies, captions and cross-references.

features.title: Tables and pages
features.body: Table styles, headers and footers, columns, page numbers, watermarks and section breaks.

features.title: Read mode and focus
features.body: A distraction-free Read mode, Focus mode, a Navigation pane and a proper dark mode.

screenshots.title: Write
screenshots.caption: The Home ribbon with fonts, paragraphs and a live styles gallery, around a real page.

screenshots.title: Review
screenshots.caption: Track changes and comments, the way your team already works.

screenshots.title: Lay it out
screenshots.caption: Multiple pages at once, with headings in the Navigation pane.

screenshots.title: Read
screenshots.caption: Read mode reflows the document into easy columns for reading on screen.

about.credit: DocDuck is based on WordCraft by the ArtCraft team, licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0, and modified by RNG Media S.L. RNG Media is not affiliated with or endorsed by the ArtCraft team.

about.intro: Build a deck with themes, shapes, charts and transitions, then present it full screen with presenter view. Opens and saves PowerPoint files.
about.description: Pick a theme, drop in your content and SlideSeal keeps it all on brand: masters, layouts, colour and font schemes. Animate what matters, rehearse your timings and present with your notes in front of you. Send it on as .pptx, PDF or an animated GIF.

features.title: Themes and layouts
features.body: Eight themes with colour and font schemes, slide masters and eleven layouts that keep everything in place.

features.title: Draw anything
features.body: Over 150 shapes, connectors that stay glued, freeform and curve tools, merge shapes, gradients, shadows and glows.

features.title: Charts, tables and media
features.body: Native charts, styled tables, pictures with crop and corrections, plus audio and video.

features.title: Transitions and animation
features.body: Transitions including Morph, entrance, emphasis, exit and motion-path animations, built by paragraph.

features.title: Present with confidence
features.body: Full-screen show with presenter view, a pen, a timer and rehearsed timings.

features.title: Plays well with others
features.body: Opens and saves .pptx. Exports PDF slides, notes and handouts, PNG, JPEG and animated GIF.

screenshots.title: Build it
screenshots.caption: Slides grouped into sections, speaker notes underneath, the ribbon on top.

screenshots.title: Shape it
screenshots.caption: Select a shape and the Shape Format tab and Format pane give you fills, lines and effects.

screenshots.title: Move it
screenshots.caption: Transitions on the ribbon, animations in their own pane, a native chart on the slide.

screenshots.title: See it all
screenshots.caption: Slide Sorter shows the whole story, section by section, with each slide’s transition.

about.credit: SlideSeal is based on DeckCraft by the ArtCraft team, licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0, and modified by RNG Media S.L. RNG Media is not affiliated with or endorsed by the ArtCraft team.

about.pitch: Crisp vector art, at any size.
about.intro: Draw logos, posters and illustrations with the Pen, Pathfinder and live effects. Opens and saves SVG and PDF, and stays fast with thousands of shapes.
about.description: The tools, panels and shortcuts you already know: the Pen and Direct Selection, Pathfinder, Smart Guides, Appearance, Swatches and Layers. Draw on as many artboards as you need, then export SVG, PDF or PNG for every screen in one go.

features.title: The Pen, done right
features.body: Real Bézier anchors and handles, Direct Selection, and a contextual task bar right where you draw.

features.title: Pathfinder that never fails
features.body: Exact curve booleans for unite, minus, intersect and divide, plus clipping masks and compound paths.

features.title: Live effects
features.body: Outer glow, shadows, live blends, gradient mesh, envelope distort and radial repeat, all still editable.

features.title: Type and lettering
features.body: Point, area and path type, with tools for turning letters into custom shapes.

features.title: Artboards, 3D and tracing
features.body: Multiple artboards, a perspective grid, 3D Revolve and Extrude, and Image Trace to turn pictures into vectors.

features.title: Fast on big files
features.body: Rendering runs off the interface thread, so 20,000 shapes still draw in a blink.

screenshots.title: The poster
screenshots.caption: Glowing type, a Pathfinder-cut sun and clipping masks, all live in the Layers panel.

screenshots.title: Every anchor
screenshots.caption: Zoom in and edit any path point by point, with the tools you need right next to it.

screenshots.title: 3D Revolve
screenshots.caption: Turn a profile into a shaded 3D object that stays vector.

about.credit: VectorViper is based on VectorCraft by the ArtCraft team, licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0, and modified by RNG Media S.L. RNG Media is not affiliated with or endorsed by the ArtCraft team.

about.pitch: Motion graphics and VFX, without the subscription.
about.intro: Animate titles, build motion graphics and composite shots with layers, keyframes and over 300 effects. Native and GPU-fast on Mac, Windows and Linux.
about.description: Build a composition out of layers, animate anything with keyframes and the Graph Editor, stack effects, add cameras and lights, then send it to the Render Queue. The panels and shortcuts are the ones you already know, and it even opens After Effects projects.

features.title: Layers and keyframes
features.body: Solids, shapes, text, footage, nulls, adjustment layers and nested comps, animated with Bezier keyframes, Easy Ease and a Graph Editor.

features.title: Shapes and masks
features.body: Shape layers with trim paths, repeaters and wiggle, and pen-drawn masks with feather, expansion and modes.

features.title: Text animators
features.body: Point and paragraph text in any installed font, animated letter by letter with range selectors.

features.title: Expressions
features.body: JavaScript expressions with wiggle, loopOut and the pick-whip, so one value can drive another.

features.title: Over 300 effects
features.body: Blurs, colour correction, distortion, Fractal Noise, particles, keying, glows, time effects and all nine layer styles.

features.title: 3D cameras and lights
features.body: 3D layers, cameras with depth of field, and lights with soft shadows, composited on the GPU.

screenshots.title: The composition
screenshots.caption: Composition viewer, Timeline with keyframes and Effect Controls, docked the way motion designers expect.

screenshots.title: The Graph Editor
screenshots.caption: Shape the motion with value and speed graphs and draggable handles.

screenshots.title: Effects and 3D
screenshots.caption: Stack any of 300+ effects on a layer, and light a 3D scene with cameras, lights and shadows.

about.credit: Effectopus is based on EffectCraft by the ArtCraft team, licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0, and modified by RNG Media S.L. RNG Media is not affiliated with or endorsed by the ArtCraft team.

about.intro: A private voice assistant that lives on your computer. Give it any name you like; that name becomes the wake word.
about.description: Say "Hey Genio" (or the name you gave it) and ask. It opens apps, plays music, sets reminders, runs routines, reads you the page you are on and answers questions, out loud. The wake word, speech recognition and voice run on your machine, so your audio never leaves it.

features.title: Your name for it
features.body: Pick any name on first start. That's the wake word: "Hey Nova", "Hey Max". Change it any time.

features.title: Runs your computer by voice
features.body: Open apps, folders and websites, control music and volume, lock the screen, take screenshots.

features.title: Remembers for you
features.body: Reminders and routines like "work mode" that open everything you need at once.

features.title: Knows what you're looking at
features.body: Summarise the page you're on, explain selected text, or have it read aloud.

features.title: Answers anything else
features.body: Connect an AI brain (your own key) and it answers open questions with live facts from the web.

features.title: Private by design
features.body: Listening, speech recognition and the voice run locally; every add-on starts switched off.

about.credit: Genio is made by RNG Media S.L. It installs with its own installer and keeps itself up to date; RNG Studio only installs and opens it.
